member_stats.doc: Return aggregate member statistics for the caller's domain: total members, active members, frozen members, and pending invites. Reads from member_list_stats SP scoped to the caller's domain_id.

member_list_workspaces.doc: List all workspaces (hubs) a specific member belongs to within the caller's domain, including their permission level per workspace.

uid.description: ID of the member whose workspace list to retrieve

returns.description: List of workspaces the member belongs to

hub_id.description: Workspace hub ID

permission.description: Member permission value in this workspace

member_list_workspace_admins.doc: List all members in the domain who have admin-level permission (permission >= 31) in at least one workspace. Aggregates across all hubs in the domain via hub_get_workspace_admins.

returns.description: List of members who are workspace admins in at least one hub

hub_id.description: Workspace hub ID

member_save_workspace_roles.doc: Save per-workspace privilege assignments for a member. Iterates over the assignments array and calls permission_grant on each target hub DB with the specified privilege value. Existing permission row is replaced (REPLACE INTO semantics from permission_grant).

uid.description: ID of the member to update

assignments.description: JSON array of hub_id + privilege pairs. Example: [{"hub_id":"abc123","privilege":7}]. Privilege values: View=3, Chat=3, Edit=7, Admin=31.

member_device_list.doc: List all registered devices for a specific member. Returns device records from the yp.device table.

uid.description: ID of the member whose devices to list

returns.description: List of registered devices for the member

member_device_remove.doc: Remove a specific registered device for a member. Calls member_device_remove SP with uid and device_id.

device_id.description: ID of the device to remove

member_device_remove_all.doc: Remove all registered devices for a member. Calls member_device_remove_all SP with uid.

uid.description: ID of the member whose devices to remove

member_set_workspace_admin.doc: Grant admin-level permission (permission=31) to a member in a specific workspace by calling permission_grant on the hub DB with resource_id='*', assign_via='system'. Replaces any existing permission row for that member in the hub.

uid.description: ID of the member to promote to workspace admin

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

status.description: OK on success, HUB_NOT_FOUND if hub DB cannot be resolved

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

member_remove_workspace_admin.doc: Downgrade a workspace admin back to Edit-level permission (permission=7) in a specific workspace by calling permission_grant on the hub DB. Does not remove membership, only reduces privilege.

uid.description: ID of the member to demote from workspace admin

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

status.description: OK on success, HUB_NOT_FOUND if hub DB cannot be resolved

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_audit_logs.doc: Return paginated audit log entries across all hubs in the domain plus a real total count. Iterates over every hub DB in the domain, calls hub_get_audit_logs_filtered per hub for the page slice, sums hub_get_audit_logs_count for the total, merges and sorts results by ctime descending, then returns one page of 20 entries inside a {data, total, page, page_size} envelope. Known limitation: only fetches page 1 from each hub before merging, so entries beyond page 1 of any single hub may be omitted from the merged page (count is still accurate).

username.description: Filter by actor full name (LIKE match). Empty string disables filter.

from_time.description: Filter entries at or after this UNIX timestamp. 0 disables filter.

to_time.description: Filter entries at or before this UNIX timestamp. 0 disables filter.

page.description: Page number, 1-based. Page size is 20. Defaults to 1.

data.description: Paginated list of audit log entries sorted by ctime descending

hub_id.description: Source hub ID (appended by service layer)

total.description: Total entries across all hubs matching the filters

export_audit_logs.doc: Export the full unfiltered audit log (no pagination) across all hubs in the domain. Same aggregation logic as get_audit_logs but returns all matching entries sorted by ctime descending. Intended for CSV export on the client side.

username.description: Filter by actor full name (LIKE match). Empty string disables filter.

from_time.description: Filter entries at or after this UNIX timestamp. 0 disables filter.

to_time.description: Filter entries at or before this UNIX timestamp. 0 disables filter.

returns.description: Full list of matching audit log entries across all hubs, sorted by ctime descending. Same field set as get_audit_logs.

get_hub_audit_logs.doc: Return paginated audit log entries for a specific workspace hub (hub-scoped). Reads from yp.mfs_changelog filtered by hub_id. Supports date range and username filters.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

username.description: Filter by actor full name (LIKE match). Empty string disables filter.

from_time.description: Filter entries at or after this UNIX timestamp. 0 disables filter.

to_time.description: Filter entries at or before this UNIX timestamp. 0 disables filter.

returns.description: Paginated list of mfs_changelog entries for the hub sorted by timestamp descending

hub_id.description: Hub ID

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_audit_stats.doc: Return summary statistics for the Audit Logs tab header cards. security_score is still a placeholder (hardcoded 94) pending a real scoring model. high_risk_count is now real: sum of action_log entries in the time range whose category is 'admin'/'permission' or whose action is grant_access/change_policy/share_link/removed, aggregated across every hub in the domain via hub_count_high_risk_actions. storage_used_bytes is real: sum of yp.entity.space for all active hubs.

from_time.description: Range start (UNIX timestamp) — applied to high_risk_count aggregation. 0 disables.

to_time.description: Range end (UNIX timestamp) — applied to high_risk_count aggregation. 0 disables.

high_risk_count.description: Real count of risk-relevant action_log entries across hubs in the time range

storage_used_bytes.description: Sum of yp.entity.space for all active hubs in domain (float)

get_org_storage_stats.doc: Return a per-hub storage breakdown for the domain. Lists all active hubs belonging to the caller's domain with their used storage in bytes and megabytes. Reads yp.entity.space for each hub.

returns.description: List of active hubs in the domain with their storage usage

hub_id.description: Hub entity ID

used_mb.description: Storage used in megabytes, rounded to 2 decimal places

get_org_user_storage.doc: Return a paginated, sortable list of members in the domain with their individual storage usage, plus a real total count. Joins yp.drumate, yp.privilege, and yp.entity (type=drumate) to compute per-user used bytes. Returns an envelope {data, total, page, page_size} so the FE can render an honest paginator. Total is sourced from get_org_user_storage_count.

sort_by.description: Sort order. Accepted values: usage_high (default, highest usage first), usage_low (lowest usage first).

data.description: Paginated list of domain members with storage usage

used_mb.description: Storage used in megabytes, rounded to 2 decimal places

total.description: Total domain members (matches WHERE clause without pagination)

hub_member_list.doc: Return a paginated list of members in a specific workspace hub with their hub-level permission, role label, and online status. Role label is derived from permission value: HUB_OWNER (>=63), HUB_ADMIN (>=31), MEMBER (<31). Online status is resolved from yp.socket.state='active'.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

role.description: Filter by role. Accepted values: all (default), admin (permission >= 31), member (permission < 31).

returns.description: Paginated list of hub members sorted by lastname, firstname

hub_permission.description: Member permission value in this hub

role_label.description: Derived role: HUB_OWNER, HUB_ADMIN, or MEMBER

status.description: ONLINE if active socket exists, AWAY otherwise

last_active.description: MAX(ctime) from yp.socket for this member, or null

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

hub_member_stats.doc: Return summary stat cards for the Workspace Admin Member tab: total members, admins (permission >= 31), external guests (domain_id differs from hub domain), and pending invites (placeholder 0 for Round 1).

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

total_members.description: Total member count in hub (permission > 0, resource_id='*')

external_guests.description: Members whose domain_id differs from hub domain

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

hub_member_remove.doc: Remove a member from a specific workspace hub by deleting their permission row (resource_id='*') and logging a removed action via hub_add_action_log.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

uid.description: ID of the member to remove

affected.description: Number of permission rows deleted (0 or 1)

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_workspace_overview.doc: Return a domain-wide list of all workspaces visible to the calling user. Requires hub_id for scope:hub permission check but returns all workspaces the caller has admin access to in the domain via get_workspace_overview SP.

hub_id.description: Any hub_id the caller is admin of. Required for scope:hub ACL check. Does not filter results.

returns.description: List of workspaces in domain the caller has admin access to

get_hub_folders.doc: List folders within a specific workspace for the Permission tab. Calls mfs_show_node_by with type='node' to return folder nodes only. Defaults to the hub root if node_id is not provided.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

node_id.description: Parent folder node ID to list from. Defaults to hub root if omitted.

returns.description: List of folder nodes under the given parent in the hub

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_folder_permissions.doc: Get the full permissions configuration for a folder: auto revocation settings, one-time link config, member access list with privilege levels, and device access settings. Calls folder_get_permissions SP on the hub DB.

hub_id.description: ID of the workspace hub containing the folder

returns.description: Full permissions config object for the folder as returned by folder_get_permissions SP

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

save_folder_permissions.doc: Save (upsert) the full permissions configuration for a folder. Accepts the config as a JSON object or JSON string and calls folder_save_permissions SP on the hub DB.

hub_id.description: ID of the workspace hub containing the folder

config.description: Full permissions config object (or JSON string). Passed as-is to folder_save_permissions SP.

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

generate_folder_otl.doc: Generate a one-time link token for a folder. Calls folder_generate_otl SP on the hub DB with the folder nid and the caller uid. Returns the generated token data.

hub_id.description: ID of the workspace hub containing the folder

nid.description: Node ID of the folder for which to generate the OTL

returns.description: Generated OTL token data as returned by folder_generate_otl SP

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

revoke_folder_otl.doc: Revoke the existing one-time link for a folder. Calls folder_revoke_otl SP on the hub DB with the folder nid.

hub_id.description: ID of the workspace hub containing the folder

nid.description: Node ID of the folder whose OTL to revoke

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_hub_storage_stats.doc: Return storage statistics for a specific workspace hub. Calls get_hub_storage_stats SP on the hub DB passing hub_id.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

returns.description: Hub-level storage stats as returned by get_hub_storage_stats SP

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_hub_user_storage.doc: Return a paginated, sortable list of hub members with their individual storage usage within the hub. Calls get_hub_user_storage SP on the hub DB.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

sort_by.description: Sort order. Accepted values: usage_high (default), usage_low.

returns.description: Paginated list of hub members with their storage usage

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_file_versions.doc: Return a paginated list of files that have version history in a specific hub. Calls file_version_list SP on the hub DB. Optional search filters by filename.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

search.description: Filename search string (LIKE match). Empty string disables filter.

returns.description: Paginated list of files with version history, sorted by version_count descending then by mtime descending

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

get_file_version_detail.doc: Return the full version history for a specific file. Calls file_version_get SP on the hub DB. Returns two result sets: file base info and ordered version list (newest first).

hub_id.description: ID of the workspace hub containing the file

returns.description: File base info and version history as returned by file_version_get SP

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

delete_file_old_versions.doc: Delete all non-active (old) versions for a specific file, or for all files in the hub if nid is omitted. Calls file_version_delete_old SP on the hub DB.

hub_id.description: ID of the target workspace hub

nid.description: Node ID of the specific file to clean. If omitted, all files in the hub are cleaned.

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id

download_file_versions.doc: Return the list of downloadable paths or URLs for all versions of a specific file. Calls file_version_download SP on the hub DB.

hub_id.description: ID of the workspace hub containing the file

returns.description: List of version download records as returned by file_version_download SP

errors.description: get_db_name returned null for the given hub_id
